content: सैन्धव {%a.%} (-वी|{%f.%}) [सिन्धुनदीसमीपे देशे भवः अण्] .²1 Produced or born in the Sindhu-territory. .²2 Belonging to the Indus. .²3 River-born. .²4 Belonging to the sea, oceanic, marine. .{@-वः@} .²1 A horse, especially one bred in {%Sindhu%}; ‘दीर्धग्रीवा मुखालम्बमेहनाः पृथुलोचनाः . महान्तस्तनुरोमाणो बलिनः सैन्घवा हयाः ..’ <ab>com.</ab> <ls>Mb. 7. 23. 24</ls>; जिनोक्तिषु श्राद्धतयैव सैन्धवाः <ls>N. 1. 71</ls>; धावद्भिरसिधाराभिः शकलीकृतसैन्धवाः <ls>Śiva B. 22. 33</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a sage. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a country. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Jayadratha, the king of Sindh; क्रोधादुक्तं सैन्धवे चार्जुनेन <ls>Mb. 1. 1. 192</ls>. .{@-वः, -वम्@} A kind of rock-salt. .{@-वाः@} {%m.%} <ab>pl.</ab> .²1 The people inhabiting the {%Sindhu%} territory. .²2 (In drama) A kind of Prākṛt song.
